title: Sectionwise evaluation calculus for native and translated internal Hom
statement: For native adic modules over any scheme, morphisms into internal Hom are determined by evaluation on every pair of sections. Evaluation commutes with restriction and with precomposition or postcomposition of internal Hom. For a scheme isomorphism g, the inverse native pushforward Hom comparison preserves sectionwise evaluation, identifying evaluation over V after inverse pushforward with evaluation over its pullback along g.inv. For the fixed ordinary model [def-sf-native-frobenius-model-data], every twisted presentation [def-sf-twisted-action-presentation-data] has sigmaHom whose identity-slice evaluation is exactly translated identity-slice evaluation. These are the six formulas realized by the declarations of the attached module.

proof.text: Uncurry morphisms into native internal Hom by the tensor-Hom adjunction. Forget module actions and use tensor sheaf extensionality and pure tensor generation to prove the evaluation criterion. Apply naturality of native evaluation and its precomposition identity on pure tensors for the two functoriality formulas. Naturality of the tensor-comparison/evaluation composite gives restriction compatibility.

theorem pushforward_evaluation (Y : Scheme.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (g : Y ≅ Y) (M N : AdicSheaf l Y) (V : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ)
    (z : ((adicLowerStar l g.inv).obj ((AdicSheaf.ihom M).obj N)).X.obj.obj V)
    (x : ((adicLowerStar l g.inv).obj M).X.obj.obj V) :
    adicComparisonEval ((adicLowerStar l g.inv).obj M) ((adicLowerStar l g.inv).obj N) V
      (((adicLowerStarCompIhomIso l g.inv M).inv.app N).hom.hom.app V z) x =
        adicComparisonEval M N ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @WeaklyEtale ⊤ g.inv).op.obj V)
          z x
